name: twilio
description: Twilio: send SMS and WhatsApp, list and read messages and calls, place calls (node only), Lookup v2 and balance; agent sends need an opt-in and a recipient allowlist

nodes.title: Lookup number
nodes.description: Free Lookup v2: validate and format a phone number (valid, E.164, national format, country)

phone_number.description: Number in E.164 (e.g. "+6281234567890") or national format with country_code

country_code.description: ISO country for a national-format number, e.g. ID

access_token.description: Overrides the plugin's default token for this node (use a secret; needs --trust-plugin)

outputs.name: data
outputs.description: API result

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none

nodes.title: Send SMS
nodes.description: Send an SMS or MMS (paid per segment; Twilio answers with the queued message) (as an agent tool only when TWILIO_TOOL_ALLOW_SEND=1)

messaging_service_sid.description: Send through a Messaging Service (MG...) instead of `from`

media_urls.description: Public https URLs of media to attach (MMS / WhatsApp)

content_sid.description: Content template (HX...), e.g. an approved WhatsApp template

content_variables.description: Template variables as a JSON string, e.g. {"1":"Ada"}

validity_period_seconds.description: Drop the message if not sent within this many seconds

from.description: Your Twilio number in E.164, a short code or an alphanumeric sender id (or use messaging_service_sid)
